title: 2027 DT Infrastructure Undergraduate Opportunities - Engineering
rationale: The advert explicitly accepts 'eligible Temporary Graduate Visa holders,' which matches Marc's Subclass 485 (Temporary Graduate) visa directly.

It targets students currently in 2nd, 3rd or final year of an engineering degree, which does not match Marc's already-completed Advanced Diploma, though the advert itself says applicants who don't meet every requirement are still encouraged to apply.
No fixed location is given (early-career pathway across Australia), consistent with Marc's openness to relocate or travel for work.
caution: Rough fit, not an interview forecast; the program is framed around students still studying, which is the main thing to confirm.
gaps: Whether a completed Advanced Diploma graduate fits this 'undergraduate pathway' or a separate DTI graduate program exists
Specific location and rostering once matched to a project
